verdict.rationale: Bugbot responds to command-style PR comments: `cursor review` and `bugbot run` trigger reviews, and `verbose=true` makes it reply with a table of the rules it loaded. It also reads existing top-level and inline PR comments as context to build on prior feedback. However, nothing shows it answering free-form questions or giving on-demand explanations in a thread, and one user who pushed back on a fix simply got the same recommendation again after reverting. missing for 10: documented conversational Q&A replies in PR threads, on-demand explanations of findings, commands beyond triggering a review, independent corroboration of in-context answers.
